changelog: ONT-WGS Re-analyse is much faster: sourmash/GTDB (≈ 8 min per sample — the 3.6 GB index is read on one core), CheckM2, Bakta and the reference mapping keep their results in the job's work folder, keyed by the assembly checksum, database and options, and reuse them when nothing changed (the log says 'reusing … results'). Results are identical; any change to the assembly, database or settings recomputes. No restart needed for running jobs; takes effect from the next run.

previous.changelog: PDF reports (amplicon and ONT-WGS) no longer print the program name and company in the page footer — only the job label and the page number — so a report can go to a customer as it is. No backend restart needed: /report reloads the report code on every call.
